notice: Manual development before r6 freeze, separate from the 100-generation campaign. All retained trials are listed, including failures and out-of-search-range diagnostics. The CEM campaign itself has frozen source hashes and complete candidate/episode records.
chosenManualBaselineNotice: Angular braking feedforward was an explicit engineering change. The handcrafted descent cap 4.5 m/s was chosen from nominal development trials; its successful trial was not a learned CEM policy. The 8 m/s diagnostic remained outside formal CEM bounds.
